_template_notice: Executable query specification template for run_kg_queries.py (>= 3 real queries including cross-paper comparison, multi-hop/neighborhood evidence retrieval, conflict audit, and negative/unverifiable query handling).

queries.description: Retrieve all evidence-grounded neighbors and operating conditions around a target concept or method.
List all concepts referenced across >= 2 distinct source_id papers while separating paper-specific samples, conditions, and metrics.
Detect opposing or contradictory relations across papers or operating regimes with verbatim evidence.
Check whether a verified path connects two queried entities; honestly report 'unverifiable_not_connected' when no evidence path exists.
